summary: Iteration-2 re-test of IT-Tabelander after main agent's 7 regression fixes. Backend: 69/69 pytest passed (51 existing + 18 new regression tests covering lockout->429, bcrypt/httpOnly/CORS playbook checks, admin id 404/400 guards for services|faqs|reviews, per-category PC configurator images). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): input contrast fixed on /kontakt, /admin, /reparatur step 6 (bg rgba(30,41,59,.6) + fg rgb(248,250,252)) in dark mode and readable in light mode; admin login works and ALL 10 admin sections render without blank page or React error; admin CRUD (service create, review create, Dolibarr demo sync, settings save with 'Einstellungen gespeichert' toast) verified; PS5 configurator live SVG + summary + saved config id (eGI6-5CweNY); PC configurator has 8 distinct per-category thumbnails, AM5+Z790 shows 'CPU-Sockel (AM5) passt nicht zum Mainboard (LGA1700)', full config saves (uDvUQ8EqY_o); all 7 public pages load with zero console errors and NO anonymous 401 /api/auth/me; theme toggle switches and persists via localStorage it_theme; consent banner closes and stores it_consent_v1; repair wizard e2e returned REP-WKAKAJ. All regression fixes CONFIRMED. login_attempts collection cleared (0) and admin login returns 200 post-test.

minor.issue: Ingress/CDN answers CORS preflight itself with 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' and no 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials'. FastAPI itself is correct (verified on 127.0.0.1:8001: allow-credentials=true + explicit origin echo). Not app code; only affects hypothetical cross-origin cookie use, current frontend is same-origin. Informational.

issues: Fixed cookie consent banner (z-[90]) overlays the sticky summary card CTA ('Als Anfrage senden' / 'Gesamt' total) until it is dismissed - CTA needed scroll_into_view to click. Consider bottom padding on page content while the banner is open.
Clicking 'Als Anfrage senden' with an incomplete configuration produces no visible toast/inline error; user only sees the small 'Noch offen: ram, storage, psu, case' hint in the summary.
Bottom block ('Website ansehen' + admin e-mail) is tightly spaced/low contrast (text-muted on dark) compared to nav items.

action_items: Optional: add bottom padding / offset so the consent banner never covers configurator CTAs.
Optional: show an inline error or disable-with-tooltip when submitting an incomplete PC configuration.
Optional (infra note only): cross-origin cookie auth would fail because the ingress answers preflight with '*'; app-level CORS is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_pc_configurator() / seed_ps5 only run when count_documents == 0, so future changes to PC_CAT_IMAGES or option data will NOT reach an already-seeded DB. Consider an idempotent upsert-by-key seed or a seed version marker.
auth.py registers a failure counter for both 'ip:email' and 'email:' but no IP-only counter - a distributed attacker can still enumerate many accounts from one IP. Low risk, note only.
/api/admin/{services,faqs,reviews} expose only PUT/DELETE (no GET list); admin UI reads the public endpoints. Fine, but GET on those admin paths returns 405 which can confuse API consumers/tooling.
seed_data_creation: Created and then DELETED: service 'TEST_QA_Service', review 'TEST_QA_Author'. Left in DB (harmless demo submissions): repair request REP-WKAKAJ (TEST_QA Tester / qa-tester@example.com), 2 saved configurator entries (eGI6-5CweNY, uDvUQ8EqY_o), 1 contact-form-adjacent input test (not submitted). login_attempts collection cleared to 0.
test_credentials: admin@it-tabelander.at / ITtabelander2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - verified working, bcrypt hash starts with $2b$, httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies set on login
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q' for the full 69-test regression suite (test_api.py + test_regression_iter2.py). test_regression_iter2.py locks the real admin account on purpose and then clears the login_attempts collection directly in Mongo - if a run is interrupted mid-test the admin will stay locked for 15 min; clear it with db.login_attempts.delete_many({}). Use /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_data.py to purge TEST_* services/reviews/faqs (admin routers have no GET list; listing goes through public /api/{res}). Playwright notes: use data-testid 'theme-toggle', 'consent-reject'/'consent-accept' (generic get_by_text('Nur notwendige') click does not reliably dismiss the banner and header's first button is 'Mehr' dropdown, not the theme toggle). PC configurator requires selecting one option in every required category before pc-request produces pc-saved.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found this iteration. Two initially suspected frontend failures ('theme toggle not working', 'consent banner not closing') were RCA'd to my own selector choices (header first button = 'Mehr' dropdown; text-based consent click hit a non-button node) - both work correctly via their data-testids. The 'pc-saved missing' first observation was RCA'd to submitting an incomplete configuration (required ram/storage/psu/case unselected), not a bug; with all categories selected the save returns a config id.
